subject: general
question: Kuna is the currency of which one of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Croatia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The kuna was the currency of **Croatia** from 1994 until January 1, 2023, when it was replaced by the euro (€).
 
• Zagreb is the capital of Croatia.
